name: FiltPoGa Portfolio Gallery
author: zz3300

sections.description:
FiltPoGa Portfolio Gallery lets you manage a category-filterable portfolio from the WordPress admin and display it with a shortcode.

  • Custom post type: Portfolio Items
  • Custom taxonomy: Portfolio Categories (used as filter buttons)
  • Featured image as the portfolio thumbnail
  • Optional subtitle and custom link per item
  • Shortcode: [filtpoga_gallery]
  • Optional attributes: columns=”2|3|4″, show_all=”1|0″
  • Lightweight fade + scale filter animation (toggle in Settings)
  • No external JS library required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the filtpoga-portfolio-gallery folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Portfolio → Categories and create categories
  4. Go to Portfolio → Add New, set title, featured image, assign categories
  5. Place shortcode [filtpoga_gallery] on any page or post
  6. Optional: Portfolio → Settings → enable/disable filter animation
sections.faq:
What is the shortcode?

[filtpoga_gallery]

Optional: [filtpoga_gallery columns=”4″] or [filtpoga_gallery show_all=”0″]
